verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents a Techstars accelerator partnership: a dedicated immigration resource library "packaged for Techstars members" and a TECHSTARS code giving 50% off its Extraordinary Ability Bootcamp. That is both an accelerator tie-in and community pricing. Missing for 10: discounts or partner pricing on the core legal packages, documented VC-portfolio arrangements (the investors page describes only a consultation), other accelerator partnerships such as YC, and independent corroboration.
